{{Quote|You will not do anything until I give the order.''"<br />"''We have our orders, Emir.|[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] and TA-175|audio=WeHaveOurOrders-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
'''TA-175''' was [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor's]] personal [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] who served him during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].

==History==
{{Quote|I am afraid Emir Tambor refused to retreat in time.''"<br />"''That is&hellip;unfortunate.|TA-175 and Count Dooku|audio=ThatIsUnfortunate-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
[[File:TA175Tambor-LoR.png|thumb|left|200px|TA-175 confers with Wat Tambor]]
The droid accompanied Emir Wat Tambor to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] when Tambor took over the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] as his own personal base. Towards the end of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|battle]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] led an assault on the capital with a grand goal to capture Tambor. The droid told [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] about the current progress which was less than positive. Tambor told Dooku that the droid had exaggerated. Dooku ordered Tambor to evacuate Ryloth and scorch the planet. Tambor was less than enthusiastic of fleeing, though the droid agreed with Dooku. Tambor insisted on taking every single item on the planet that was of any value with him on. The Tactical droid constantly warned Tambor that they didn't have much time to escape. When Windu, now allied with the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]], breached the capital, the droid lost patience with his master. He and a pair of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] approached the Emir's [[Wat Tambor's Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] as Tambor was still inside the capital.

TA-175 ordered the droids to go ahead of him and start 'his' ship, remarking that Emir Tambor was a fool for taking so long. Just as the droids entered the shuttle, Tambor and a pair of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] also came out, going toward the shuttle, but were too late. The tactical droid looked back at the Emir as the shuttle doors closed, and Tambor was left shocked as he had just missed his departing ship. Leaving Tambor behind, the unit told Count Dooku of Tambor's arrogance and Dooku was less than pleased. The count then ordered the tactical droid to tell the [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|Hyena-class bombers]] to destroy the capital. As the bombers approached, Mace Windu and Wat Tambor seemingly about to perish, they were destroyed at the last moment by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in their [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighters]]. Emir Tambor was taken captive, and the destruction of Lessu was halted.

==Personality==
{{Quote|I calculate they will reach the main gates by morning. I recommend we prepare a retreat.|TA-175 to Wat Tambor|audio=TA175Calculates-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
TA-175 has a strong sense of following orders by his superiors, even up to the point of leaving without his [[Wat Tambor/Legends|master]] to follow them.<ref name="SW:TCWVG:UB">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> Even though loyal to Tambor, TA-175 often noted the Count's superiority to Tambor.

==Behind the scenes==
TA-175 was voiced by [[Gary Scheppke]] in "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]."
